description.text:
An expansion pack of the MEGA series made for the 30th anniversary of the Pokémon Card Game, released in Japan on 16 September 2026 as part of a worldwide release, in which every card is holo. Each pack held six cards, one of them always one of 30 Pikachu cards, each drawn by a different illustrator. Many of its other cards show Pokémon going about different times of the day, such as the Art Rare Lapras singing on a sparkling sea with Shaymin, Spheal and Psyduck gathered round, Drifloon hiding among the balloons of an amusement park, Midnight Form Lycanroc in a dark back alley, and Hisuian Zorua. Pokémon ex such as Mew ex, whose Ability lets it use every attack of its player's Benched Pokémon, Mewtwo ex, Sylveon ex and Greninja ex are in it too. The cards are numbered to 103, the Pikachu cards among them, followed by Art Rare and Special Art Rare cards, the Futuristic Rare cards, the Classic Collection, and three Mew cards lettered R, G and B and printed in red, green and blue. In English nearly all of its cards came out in 30th Celebration, part of the same worldwide release.

The set brought a new rarity, the Futuristic Rare (FUR): brightly colored cards meant to stir hope for an unknown future, drawn by the graphic artist YOSHIROTTEN, here for Mewtwo ex and Mew ex. Its Classic Collection brings back 30 cards that stand for the game's 30 years in a special finish and in their original card designs, from the Charizard of the first Pokémon Card Game series to Pikachu & Zekrom-GX of the Sun & Moon series. None of these reprints could be played in the Standard format in force when the set was announced, though they can be used in formats that allow the cards they reprint.
